details.response_text:
Step 1. Analyze the question and identify the relevant metrics:
The relevant metrics for determining the node hosting pods for the ts-voucher-service that currently has the most free space on its filesystem on the /dev/sda2 device are:
- The metric "node_filesystem_free_bytes" provides information about the free space available on the filesystem in bytes. This metric is crucial for identifying the free space on the filesystem.
- The metric "node_filesystem_avail_bytes" indicates the filesystem space available to non-root users in bytes. This metric can also be used to determine the available space on the filesystem.
- The metric "node_filesystem_device_error" could be useful to check if any errors occurred while getting statistics for the given device.
Step 2. Relevant Metrics List:
```
- {"name": "node_filesystem_free_bytes", "type": "gauge", "description": "Filesystem free space in bytes."}
- {"name": "node_filesystem_avail_bytes", "type": "gauge", "description": "Filesystem space available to non-root users in bytes."}
- {"name": "node_filesystem_device_error", "type": "gauge", "description": "Whether an error occurred while getting statistics for the given device."}
```

The relevant metrics for the filesystem usage and limit bytes for all containers of the auth service are:
- The metric "container_fs_usage_bytes" indicates the number of bytes currently consumed by the container on the filesystem. This measures the actual filesystem usage by the container.
- The metric "container_fs_limit_bytes" denotes the maximum number of bytes that can be consumed by the container on this filesystem. This represents the limit set for filesystem usage by the container.
